es: Usar adjetivos evaluativos precisos para describir trama, actuación y ritmo de una película y destacar lo que más gustó.

teaching.en: The plot is so gripping that, even though the film lasts almost three hours, nobody in the cinema looked at their phones.
teaching.es: La trama es tan absorbente que, aunque la película dura casi tres horas, nadie en el cine miró su teléfono.
teaching.explanationEs: Plot = trama; gripping = absorbente: no puedes dejar de mirar.
segments: The plot is so gripping that, even though the film lasts
almost three hours, nobody in the cinema looked at their phones.
teaching.audioText: The plot is so gripping that, even though the film lasts almost three hours, nobody in the cinema looked at their phones.

teaching.en: Although the ending is predictable, the central idea is so far-fetched that the director has to work hard to make us believe it.
teaching.es: Aunque el final es predecible, la idea central es tan inverosímil que el director tiene que esforzarse para que nos la creamos.
teaching.explanationEs: Predictable = predecible; far-fetched = inverosímil, difícil de creer.
segments: Although the ending is predictable, the central idea is so far-fetched that
the director has to work hard to make us believe it.
teaching.audioText: Although the ending is predictable, the central idea is so far-fetched that the director has to work hard to make us believe it.

teaching.en: Her performance was understated and completely convincing: she hardly raises her voice, yet we believe every word she says.
teaching.es: Su interpretación fue contenida y totalmente convincente: apenas levanta la voz, y aun así creemos cada palabra.
teaching.explanationEs: Performance = interpretación; understated = sin exageración; convincing = creíble.
segments: Her performance was understated and completely convincing: she hardly raises
her voice, yet we believe every word she says.
teaching.audioText: Her performance was understated and completely convincing: she hardly raises her voice, yet we believe every word she says.

teaching.en: Some actors seemed wooden, while others were over the top, and neither extreme helped the scene to feel real.
teaching.es: Algunos actores parecían acartonados y otros exagerados, y ningún extremo ayudó a que la escena resultara real.
teaching.explanationEs: Wooden = rígido, sin emoción; over the top = exagerado.
segments: Some actors seemed wooden, while others were over the top,
and neither extreme helped the scene to feel real.
teaching.audioText: Some actors seemed wooden, while others were over the top, and neither extreme helped the scene to feel real.

teaching.en: The pace is slow at first, but the final scene is deeply moving, which is why many critics forgive the long opening.
teaching.es: El ritmo es lento al principio, pero la escena final es profundamente conmovedora, por eso muchos críticos perdonan el largo comienzo.
teaching.explanationEs: Pace = ritmo; moving = conmovedor (no moved: moved describe a quien siente).
segments: The pace is slow at first, but the final scene is
deeply moving, which is why many critics forgive the long opening.
teaching.audioText: The pace is slow at first, but the final scene is deeply moving, which is why many critics forgive the long opening.

teaching.en: What annoyed me most was how formulaic the script felt: every twist was exactly what we expect from a thriller.
teaching.es: Lo que más me molestó fue lo convencional que resultaba el guion: cada giro era justo lo que esperamos de un thriller.
teaching.explanationEs: Formulaic = hecho con fórmula, sin originalidad; What … was … es la oración enfática.
segments: What annoyed me most was how formulaic the script felt:
every twist was exactly what we expect from a thriller.
teaching.audioText: What annoyed me most was how formulaic the script felt: every twist was exactly what we expect from a thriller.

prompt.es: Elige el adjetivo que resume el juicio del crítico.

choices.text: Gripping: the viewer cannot look away.
Far-fetched: events are hard to believe.

feedback.es: Quien adivina cada giro desde el principio describe una película predictable, no absorbente ni inverosímil.

hint.es: Piensa en qué adjetivo describe lo que se adivina de antemano.

origin.text: Review: 'Every twist was exactly what I expected from the first ten minutes, so I was never surprised.'

prompt.es: Completa: «La actuación resultó acartonada porque recitaban sin sentimiento.»

accepted: wooden
stiff
flat
lifeless
robotic

feedback.es: Wooden describe una actuación rígida y sin emoción, como la de quien recita un texto.

hint.es: Es el adjetivo que significa rígido y sin sentimiento.

origin.text: Nobody in the film spoke like a real person. The acting felt ___ because the actors said their lines without any feeling at all.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Lo que más me gustó fue la interpretación contenida.»

answer.text: What I liked most was the understated performance

feedback.es: What I liked most was + lo destacado forma la oración enfática: aquí, la interpretación contenida.

hint.es: Empieza por What I liked most.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada reseña breve con el adjetivo que resume el juicio.

pairs: I could not stop watching until the last minute.
Nobody would ever act like that in real life.
She said little, yet we understood everything.
The actors shouted every line and waved their arms.
I guessed the ending in the first ten minutes.

feedback.es: Cada juicio describe un aspecto distinto: la trama (gripping, far-fetched, predictable) o la interpretación (understated, over the top).

pairs: I could not stop watching until the last minute.
Nobody would ever act like that in real life.

The actors shouted every line and waved their arms.

prompt.es: Escucha la reseña y elige qué salvó la película para el crítico.

choices.text: The surprising twist at the end of the plot.
The fast pace of the action scenes.
The quiet performance of a supporting actor.

feedback.es: El crítico salva solo la interpretación contenida de un actor secundario; la trama y el protagonista le parecen exagerados.

origin.audio: This week I watched a thriller that everybody is praising, and I am afraid I cannot join the party. The plot is so far-fetched that I stopped believing it after twenty minutes, and the lead actor is so over the top that every scene feels like a school play. What saved the film for me was a supporting actor, whose understated performance was honestly the only convincing thing on the screen.

prompt.es: Escribe una oración enfática: «Lo que más me gustó fue el ritmo.»

answer.text: What I liked most was the pace of the film.

origin.text: Lo que más me gustó fue el ritmo de la película.

prompt.es: Escucha la crítica y elige qué destaca el crítico de la película.

choices.text: The quiet performance of the lead actor.
The slow pace, which he enjoys more than anything else.
The story, which he remembers better than the acting.

feedback.es: Destaca la interpretación sobria del protagonista, que apenas levanta la voz; admite que la historia no es original y que el ritmo es lento, y eso no lo elogia.

origin.audio: I went to see the new drama expecting very little, and I was wrong. The pace is slow, yes, and the plot is hardly original, but the lead actor hardly raises her voice, yet you move to the edge of your seat to catch every word. It is not the story that stays in the mind; it is the silence between the lines. I would not call it gripping, but it is undeniably convincing.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige cuál es la valoración global del crítico.

choices.text: Negative, because the slow pace spoils the film for him.
Positive, although he admits the film is slow and not original.
Enthusiastic, because the film is gripping from the first minute to the last.

feedback.es: Empieza esperando poco y acaba elogiando la interpretación, pero dice que no es absorbente: es positiva con reservas.

origin.audio: I went to see the new drama expecting very little, and I was wrong. The pace is slow, yes, and the plot is hardly original, but the lead actor hardly raises her voice, yet you move to the edge of your seat to catch every word. It is not the story that stays in the mind; it is the silence between the lines. I would not call it gripping, but it is undeniably convincing.

prompt.es: Completa: «Aunque no hubo gritos, la interpretación fue contenida.»

accepted: understated
restrained
subtle
subdued
muted
low-key

feedback.es: Understated es lo contrario de over the top: emociones fuertes contadas sin exagerar.

origin.text: The director trusted the audience, so even the saddest scenes felt ___ rather than over the top: nobody shouted, and nothing was explained twice.

prompt.es: Lee la crítica. ¿Qué actitud transmite hacia la película?

choices.text: Positive: it finds the whole film gripping and only doubts the lead actor.
Negative: it praises the ending but finds the opening too slow.
Mixed: it likes the opening and the lead actor but finds the ending hard to believe.

feedback.es: Elogia la primera hora y al protagonista, pero critica el final inverosímil: la actitud es mixta, no positiva sin reservas ni negativa.

origin.text: Review: 'The film has a gripping first hour, but the last act is so far-fetched that I wanted the thriller to end sooner. Even so, the lead actor is convincing enough to keep you watching until the very last scene.'

prompt.es: Lee la crítica. ¿Qué quiere decir el crítico con «formulaic»?

choices.text: That the twists follow a pattern so familiar that they no longer surprise.
That the twists are too unlikely to be believable.
That the script copies a famous scene from another film.

feedback.es: Formulaic significa hecho con una fórmula conocida: por eso no hay suspense, aunque la fotografía sea buena.

origin.text: Review: 'Nothing in the script is surprising: the twists are so formulaic that the suspense disappears, yet the camera work is beautiful and the final scene is surprisingly moving.'

prompt.es: Completa: «Todos elogiaron a los actores, pero lo que mejor recuerdo es el silencio.»

accepted: what

feedback.es: What I remember best is… es una oración enfática: what introduce lo que se destaca.

origin.text: Everybody praised the actors and the plot. Personally, ___ I remember best is the long silence in the last scene.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El ritmo era lento, pero el final fue profundamente conmovedor.»

answer.text: The pace was slow but the ending was deeply moving

feedback.es: Deeply moving intensifica al adjetivo moving; el contraste slow but … lo marca la conjunción but.
